I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An Allotment of land with the below mentioned name and extent depicted in the Advance Tracing No. GM/BIY/2024/21 dated 04.03.2024, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Siyambalape in the Grama Niladhari Division of Siyambalape North in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Biyagama in Gampaha District of the Western Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot No. 3 – Delgahawatta – Extent: 0.3035 Hectare North: Puwakgahalanda claimed by P. G. Asela Sanjeewa, the name untraceable land claimed by P. G. Chandrasiri,

the name untraceable land claimed by P. G. Somachandra and WP/Kela/Daranagama Primary School; East: WP/Kela/Daranagama Primary School, Lot Nos. 1 and 2; South: Lot No. 2 and the claimant untraceable land called Delgahawatta; West: Puwakgahalanda claimed by P. G. Asela Sanjeewa, the name untraceable land claimed by P. G. Chandrasiri and the name untraceable land claimed by P. G. Somachandra.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
My No.: 4-3/8/2017/PC/135.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.08th January, 2025.
